ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. ________ Smith made a recording of it, I believe. He's the one who did the vocal, ________ Smith. I thought it was a very good tune. I would have loved to have done it as a single on an album, because it was a very good tune and I liked it very much. I only played it the one time we rehearsed it. We ran it down one
time, to see if the notes were all correct on it and then we cut it and I have never played it before or since.
